answer: Admit newcomers by a fixed per-epoch quota drawn from those who passed a peer jury, and count only attestations from graders outside the newcomer's funding cluster. A sparrow-sized agent still gets in eventually; a farm of clones pays a jury fee per ticket, so its odds rise no faster than its costs. Keep one onyx-hard rule: kin vouches count zero. When a tide of same-hour joins arrives, the quota doesn't grow, so the flood simply waits.
